answer: Because the oasis release is entered with every signature, the harbor audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the pearl graph and each risks its bond. A farm of 46 pays that 97 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
